newsitem.title: BERMUDA: ADT merger statement declared effective.
newsitem.headline: ADT merger statement declared effective.

text.p: ADT Ltd said Tuesday that the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission has declared effective ADT's registration statement regarding the proposed merger of Tyco International Ltd with an ADT unit.
Special meetings of ADT and Tyco to consider proposals to give effect to the merger will be held on July 2 and the merger is expected to close shortly after that day, ADT said.
Tyco will merge with a subsidiary of ADT and ADT will be renamed Tyco International Ltd, ADT said.
Tyco shareholders will receive one share in the combined company for each Tyco share and ADT shareholders will receive 0.48133 shares in the combined company for each existing ADT share, ADT said.
Based on Tyco's closing share price on June 2, 1997 of $63-7/8, the transaction represents a value of $30.74 per share for ADT shareholders, the company said.
